Download and install a supported Zig compiler

Source: R/install-zig.R
install_zig.Rd

Downloads the Zig release version for this platform, verifies the archive against the size and SHA-256 that https://ziglang.org/download/index.json publishes (pinned in rzig), and unpacks it into dir. find_zig() and the configure scripts of packages created with use_rzig() find compilers installed in zig_home(), so R CMD INSTALL of such a package needs no further setup.

Usage

install_zig(
  version = "0.16.0",
  dir = zig_home(),
  mirrors = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

uninstall_zig(version = NULL, dir = zig_home())

zig_home()

Arguments

version

The Zig release: "0.16.0" or "0.17.0".

dir

The folder that holds the installations.

mirrors

If FALSE, download from ziglang.org only.

quiet

If TRUE, show no download progress.

Value

install_zig(): the path of the zig executable, invisibly. uninstall_zig(): the folders removed, invisibly. zig_home(): a path.

Details

The archive (about 55 MB, about 300 MB unpacked) comes from one of the community mirrors of Zig, tried in an order that varies between sessions, or else from ziglang.org, as the Zig Software Foundation asks of automated downloads. A download whose size or SHA-256 differs from the pin is deleted before anything is extracted or run. An existing installation of the same version is reused. uninstall_zig() removes installations made by install_zig().

zig_home() is the folder named by the environment variable RZIG_ZIG_HOME, or zig in the user cache folder of rzig (tools::R_user_dir()).

Examples

zig_home()
#> [1] "/home/runner/.cache/R/rzig/zig"
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
install_zig("0.16.0")
find_zig()
} # }
